text:
maria gonzalez: heads-up — attempting to plug the new next-edge starter (Next.js + LangChain + LlamaIndex) into the monorepo sample and seeing an auth/retry loop on Edge.
alex chen: hitting it too. deploy the next-edge sample, call /api/generate which uses redwood-sdk edge fetch wrapper. sometimes returns 401 then the client keeps retrying forever. seems authorization header is missing on retries.
jamal: confirmed on node sdk as well. retry wrapper rebuilds Request but doesn't copy `req.headers.get('authorization')`.
yoni: filed infra issue 3421 and added a minimal failing test: https://git.redwood/infra/issues/3421 — reproduction points at @redwood/sdk-edge fetch.
devex-bot: Issue 3421 created by yoni — labels: bug, sdk, edge
tina: low friction fix for starter: add an explicit `authorization` header in the sample helper and call it out in README. prevents new devs from getting stuck.
alex chen: quick patch idea for retry handler:
```
const headers = new Headers(origReq.headers);
if (!headers.has('authorization') && ctx.token) headers.set('authorization', `Bearer ${ctx.token}`);
const retryReq = new Request(origReq, { headers });
```
keeps headers identical across attempts.
maria gonzalez: agree. also add an eval harness check: run sample with synthetic token expiry and assert that retry occurs at most once and finishes, to catch regressions.
jamal: I'll add a smoke e2e under samples that injects flaky auth responses and asserts no infinite loop. runs with `yarn test:samples`.
yoni: propose updating starter README section "Edge notes" with the explicit header pattern and mention SDK-edge caveat until fixed.
tina: customers on Dedicated hit this during onboarding — can we hotfix starter template published on npm/github while sdk-edge patch lands?
alex chen: will open PR to monorepo/starter-next to include the workaround and bump sdk-edge dependency once fix is merged. tagging @maria for README review.
maria gonzalez: I'll review the PR and add the eval-harness CI job: `eval-harness run --sample monorepo-starter --simulate-auth-failures`.
yoni: PR 3422 created: https://git.redwood/infra/pulls/3422 — includes unit test + README snippet.
jamal: temporary workaround snippet added to sample code; local smoke test passes :thumbsup: 
maria gonzalez: thanks all. follow-up: add one-line note in onboarding checklist for Solutions Eng to triage 401s on Edge starter quickly. :white_check_mark:
